why: The table, the pure module, the helper and the admin card are specified exactly. make_it_cheaper: Name the exact component and file that carries the 'store', 'pay' and 'site' calls (or drop those three kinds from this step), so commit 2 needs no search in the cached tree.

src/app/s/[store]/[market]/checkout/page.tsx awaits only params, resolveShop and sellingPageOr404, with no cookies() or connection() read as the brief assumes
